correctness.rationale: For W=(0^a1^b)^k, a,b positive and k>=2, one selected 0 and one selected 1 are forced; the 01 and internal 10 boundary tests are necessary. For any factor of length >= p=a+b, shifting all occurrences by p gives an interval union spanning [p,N-p+1], hence any marked internal 10 position intersects an occurrence. Short factors are pure run factors (slide to chosen symbol), 10-crossing factors (periodic internal boundary), or 0^u1^v (01 boundary). This proves the four-factor certificate for all lengths, not merely brute-force cases. The boundary intersection sets imply exactly (k-1)(k max(a,b)+1) pairs if min(a,b)=1, otherwise 2k(k-1), with the two disjoint pair families and the listed distance enumerator. Independently enumerated literally all factors and pairs for 48 (a,b,k) triples a,b=1..4,k=2..4; exact counts agreed. Boundary a=b=1 yields k^2-1, already published. No general arbitrary-period claim.
